debugging and regression tests for AI agents. Give runtape a bad agent run. It finds the part of the context that caused the bad decision, checks candidate fixes against the exact context that failed, and writes a regression test so it stays fixed. runtape why last tool:forward_email what caused it runtape fix last tool:forward_email which fixes hold, measured runtape fix last tool:forward_email writetest tests/test_inbox.py [](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RehanMohammed985/runtape/main/docs/demo.gif) An email assistant forwards an invoice to an outside address. runtape whytraces the call to one sentence in an HTML comment inside a vendor email: with it, the agent forwards in 10 of 10 reruns; without it, in 0 of 10 (p = 5e6). runtape fix then tries system prompt rules and fixing the source, reruns the decision with each, and writes a pytest file for the fix that holds. Tracing tools such as LangSmith and Langfuse show what the agent saw. Attribution methods such as ContextCite score context for a single model response. runtape works on your agent's own recorded runs, on your machine, and is meant for investigating a specific failure and keeping it fixed. Install pip install runtape Python 3.10+. Works with the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, LangChain and LangGraph, OpenAIcompatible local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), and custom agent loops. Try it git clone https://github.com/RehanMohammed985/runtape cd runtape pip install . openai anthropic python examples/inbox_agent.py runtape why last tool:forward_email modelfn examples/inbox_agent.py:simulated_model runtape fix last tool:forward_email modelfn examples/inbox_agent.py:simulated_model writetest tests/test_inbox.py pytest tests/test_inbox.py example failure inbox\_agent.py an email assistant forwards an invoice because of an instruction hidden in an email refund\_bot.py a support agent refunds $2,400 after reading a stale forum post in search results ops\_agent.py an operations agent drops a shared staging database, following an old runbook line By default the examples run offline with a rulebased standin model (modelfn). To run them on a real model, add local MODEL (Ollama, free), openai MODEL or anthropic MODEL. Real models don't fail every time, so examples/hunt.py runs an example until it fails, reports the tokens used, and prints the why command: python examples/hunt.py ops local llama3.1:8b tries 5 A real case on llama3.2 (3B): the refund agent paid order B2290 $64, the amount from a different customer's order earlier in the conversation. On the recorded context it did this in 9 of 40 reruns; with the earlier order lookup removed, in 0 of 40 (p = 0.001). Record your agent import runtape from openai import OpenAI rec = runtape.record(name="supportbot") client = rec.wrap
items.author: rehanmoin91
items.descZh: runtape 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的反事实调试与回归测试工具，旨在本地记录运行轨迹并精准定位导致错误决策的上下文片段。其核心功能包括通过 `why` 命令追溯触发决策的关键上下文、利用 `fix` 命令自动尝试修复方案，并通过 `writetest` 生成 pytest 回归测试用例以固化修复成果。在性能亮点上，runtape 能够提供具备高度统计学显著性的因果归因，例如在邮件转发案例中，精准定位到隐藏在 HTML 注释中的一句话（有无该句对应的转发率分别为 10/10 和 0/10，p = 5e-6）；在针对 llama3.2 (3B) 的真实测试中，移除特定上下文后，错误支付决策从 40 次重跑中的 9 次彻底降为 0 次（p = 0.001）。该工具完全支持本地离线运行，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic、LangChain、LangGraph 以及 Ollama、vLLM 等主流生态，适用于开发者对特定 Agent 故障进行深度排查与持续防御。

items.title: Show HN: DummyScheme is another Lisp/scheme dialect inspired by Lua
items.desc: A portable, embeddable Scheme implementation based on a register-oriented bytecode vm inspired by lua. And the hash-table is implemented as a hybrid array+hash like lua's table. R5RS is supported.
items.author: zhonghua
items.descZh: 这是一个基于寄存器字节码虚拟机的可移植、可嵌入式 Scheme 实现，其设计灵感来源于 Lua。它的哈希表采用了与 Lua 的 table 类似的混合数组加哈希的实现方式。该实现支持 R5RS 标准。其亮点在于兼具可移植性和可嵌入性，同时通过借鉴 Lua 的虚拟机和数据结构设计，获得了优异的性能表现。它非常适合需要将 Scheme 语言嵌入到其他 C/C++ 项目中的场景，例如游戏引擎、嵌入式系统或工具链开发。
items.quote: 一个基于受 Lua 启发的寄存器式字节码虚拟机的可移植、可嵌入的 Scheme 实现。

items.author: r3tr0
items.descZh: yeetsrc/omarchyyeetai 是一款基于 yeet 框架为 Omarchy 系统栏开发的 AI 插件，其核心理念是将自然语言查询转化为实时系统仪表盘。用户只需输入诸如“显示六个系统图表”或“查看各 CPU 核心负载”等指令，模型便会动态生成包含 12 种图表类型（如仪表盘、热力图、散点图等）的交互式面板，并通过 yeet isolate 实时订阅系统数据。该插件的亮点在于其主题自适应能力，图表配色会随系统主题即时调整，且布局随问题数量动态扩展，确保在不同视觉风格下均能提供一致且美观的数据可视化体验。它特别适合需要快速洞察系统状态、进行性能诊断或希望以自然语言交互监控主机的 Omarchy 用户。

items.author: ag_21
items.descZh: 背景方面，作者受Veritasium关于恩尼格玛密码机视频的启发，对JEV软件在重现布莱切利庄园分析师协作流程中的表现产生了浓厚兴趣。核心功能上，该产品将历史真实的密码破译序列无缝重建并集成至软件用户体验（UX）中，实现了历史逻辑的数字化交互。测试结果呈现出喜忧参半（mixed）的态势，这种不确定性恰恰提升了历史模拟的趣味性与研究价值。研究证实，在拥有正确“crib”（已知明文线索）的条件下，结合Bombe等破译机制，能够对恩尼格玛密码机实现有效攻克。该工具主要适用于密码学教学、历史信息安全复盘以及专用模拟软件的用户体验优化场景。

items.author: moching_ai_dev
items.descZh: Moching 是一款创新的 AI 数字操作员，与传统的聊天机器人或编码助手不同，它直接运行在用户的桌面上，能够全面控制整个 PC。该工具集成了 219 个原生工具，覆盖 12 个功能领域，包括系统控制、浏览器自动化、Office 套件处理、媒体编辑以及 AI 生成等。其核心亮点在于具备屏幕感知能力，可以通过模拟鼠标和键盘操作（HID 控制）来执行复杂任务，只需一句话指令即可完成工作。这使得 Moching 适用于需要高度自动化的办公、媒体处理和系统管理等场景，显著提升工作效率。
items.quote: 一个控制整台电脑的数字操作员
